title: Single-Serve Sticks Before the Flight
lessons: The player is buying water before a flight and notices that Liquid I.V. comes as single-serve powder sticks made to be mixed into a bottle.
The player already uses Liquid I.V. and gets a reminder before the next subscription shipment.

text: The player is buying water before a flight and notices that Liquid I.V. comes as single-serve powder sticks made to be mixed into a bottle.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I already bought water.

entry-first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Perfect. I brought the part that fits in your pocket.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are assuming plain water is not enough for what I want.

entry-first-4.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: I am offering electrolytes in a single-serve stick. You decide whether the extra function is useful today.

choice-first.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That is actually useful for travel.
I can also just drink the water.
I do not want another thing to pack.

first-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Exactly. I earn my space when routine gets messy.

first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Absolutely. I am an option, not a requirement.

first-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then leave me home. Prepared stops being useful when it becomes clutter.
The player already uses Liquid I.V. and gets a reminder before the next subscription shipment.

entry-return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Your next box is coming up.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: How many packets do I even have left?

entry-return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: That is why I am reminding you before it ships.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: And if I have plenty?

entry-return-5.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Swap flavors, change it, pause it, or cancel. Surprise hydration is still a surprise charge.

choice-return.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like not having to remember to reorder.
I want to check whether I actually need another box.
I do not want hydration on auto-renew.

return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then the subscription is doing its one useful trick.

return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Yes. If you ignore the reminder, the subscription still has a job to do.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Which is charge me and ship it.

return-2-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Correct.

return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then cancel it. Recurring delivery only makes sense if you want recurring delivery.
